# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Student at Royal Academy

## Appearance

Hugh Carrow is described as a young man of noble bearing with short dark hair and sharp features. He typically wears the formal uniform of the Royal Academy.

## Personality

Hugh is ambitious, competitive, and proud of his noble background. He possesses a strong sense of duty toward his family's reputation, though his arrogance often blinds him to his own limitations.

## Traits

- Proud
- Ambitious
- Competitive

## Abilities

- Swordsmanship
- Basic Elemental Magic

## Goals

- Bring honor to the Carrow family name

## History

Hugh Carrow enrolled in the Royal Academy to pursue a career in state service and bring distinction to his house. During his time at the academy, he frequently clashed with rival students over rankings and academic merit. His involvement in the escalating political tensions surrounding noble houses eventually drew him into dangerous conflict, culminating in his premature death during the turmoil of the academy crisis.

## Background by volume

- Scion of the noble Carrow house

## Affiliations

- House Carrow — Scion
- Royal Academy — Student
